text.body: <1> atha asāṇaṃ svayambhaṃ gu lokapitāmaham | brahmaloke sukhāsīnaṃ kāśyapaḥ paripṛcchati ||1|| kiṃ pramāṇaṃ khādyānāṃ rātrau vā yadi vā divā | candrādityagataṃ sarvaḥ tanme prahi pṛcchataḥ ||2|| tasya śuśrayamāṇasya kārayapasya mahātmanaḥ | provāca bhagavān sarve muhūrta jñānamuttamam ||2|| dvādaśācinimeṣastu lavo nāma vidhīyate| lavāḥ triṃśatkalā jñeyā kalāliśaṃkhaṭirbhavet ||4|| buṭīnāṃ tu bhavetriṃśanmuhūrtasya prayojanam | dvādaśāṅgalamucchetasya āyā pramāṇataḥ ||5|| navatī ghaḍāṅgalāracaiva pratīcīṃ tāṃ prakāśayet | purastātsandhivelāyāṃ varṇā raudra ucyate ||6|| śvetaḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ samākhyāto maitro vai dvādaśāṅgulaḥ | ṣaṭsu sārabhaṭo yaḥ sāvitraḥ pañcasu smṛtaḥ ||7|| catuṃ taṃ vairājākhiṣu viśvavasustathā | madhyāhe abhijighrāma yāsmin āyā pratiṣṭhitā ||8|| prācīṃ vai gāminīṃ chāyāṃ rohiṇatriṣu vartate | balaścaturṣu vikhyāto vijayaḥ pañcasu smṛtaḥ ||9|| nairṛtastu paḍhagulyā vāruṇo dvādaśāṅgulaḥ | saumyaḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ samākhyāto bhagastu paramastathā ||10|| ete muhūrcā vyākhyātā daśa dvau ca tathā vayaḥ | anyeva tu vijñeyā rātrāvapi na saṃśayaḥ ||11|| ata uddhvaṃ tu sarveṣāmānupūrvyā śubhāśubham | sarva vistaraśastāvattanme nigaḍhataḥ śṛṇu ||12|| ||1|| <2> raudre raudrāṇi kurvīta rudrakāryāṇi nityaśaḥ | yaca raudraṃ mavetkiñcit sarvametena kārayet || 1|| śvete vāsaya snānaṃ ca grāmodyānaṃ tathā kṛṣiḥ | ārammāścātra sidhyanti ye cārthāścintitāḥ kvacit || 2|| maitre maivāṇi kurvīta mitrakāryāṇi nityaśaḥ | gaca maitaṃ bhavetkiñcit sarvametena kārayet ||3|| abhicāraṃ tu śatraṇāṃ kuryātsārabhaṭena tu | ātmārthe suhṛdarthe vā naśyante tasya śatravaḥ ||4|| vitreṇa muhūrcena devakāryāṇi kārayet | yajñān vivāhānavāhaṃścūḍopanayanāni ca ||5|| vairājena muhūrttena rājapauruṣamārabhet | marmāṇi paradānāni śatrakarma ca kārayet ||6|| viśvāvasau tu sarvārthānārambhāṃścāva kārayet | sarveṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ svādhyāyastu praśasyate ||7|| brahmacatriyavaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ cāpi nityaśaḥ | sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ yogo madhyandine'bhijit ||8|| abhijit sarvakāmāya sarvakāryārthasādhanaiḥ | artha sañcayamānānāmadhvānaṃ gantumicchatām ||9|| rauhiṇe vāpitā vṛkṣā bimbagulmalatāstathā | arogāḥ puṣpavanta phalavantaśca nityaśaḥ ||10|| balena tu balaṃ rājā svayamāruya yojayet | yogaḥ sampattikaṃ kārya śatrūṃśca viṣame jayet || 11 || 2 || <3> vijayena prayātasya vijayo nātra saṃśayaḥ | maṃṅgalānyale kurvīta śāntiḥ svasthyayanāni ca ||1|| naiṛte dyotayetsenāṃ pararāṣṭaṃ tu maīyet | karttaḥ sampatkaro śeṣa sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 2 || vāruṇena muhūrtena vāruṇāni pravāpayet | godhūmān yavaśālīṃścai icava śrotpalāni ca ||3|| saumye saumyāni kurvīta somakāryāṇi nityaśaḥ | yaca saumyaṃ bhavetkiñcit sarvamevena kārayet ||4|| sarvāsāmeva nārīṇāṃ kanyānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | saubhāgyāni prayujīta bhage bhīmaparākrame ||5|| bhagena varaveda kanyāṃ brāhmaṇa kulavarddhanīm | bhagena baritā kanyā naiva sānyatra gacchati ||6||3|| <4> śuklapratipadirātrau' divi pañcamyāṃ tathāṣṭamīṃ rātrau | dvādaśyāmapi ca divā prathamaṃ pratipadyate karaṇam || 1|| paurṇamāsyāṃ navaṃ rātrau tacaturthyā punardivā | taddhi tatsaptamīrātrau tacaivaikādaśī divā ||2|| śubhāśubhanibaddhāni karaṇāni nirvāodhata | tāni tatvena vijñāya nāpadaṃ prāpnuyānaraḥ ||3|| ekādaśabhiḥ karaṇairmāsaḥ sampratipadyate | bhavāṇi tatra catvāri calānyanyāṃni sapta ca ||4|| navaṃ ca pālavaṃ caiva kaulavaṃ taitileti ca | garāja' vaṇijaṃ caiva viṣṭirbhavati saptamam ||5|| śakuniṃ catuṣpadaṃ nāgaṃ caturtha kaustumaṃ bhavet | ekakasya tu yatkarma tadvakṣyāmi pṛthak pṛthak ||6|| ādyaṃ tu śakuniṃ nāma rātrau kṛṣṇacaturdaśī | ādhā haraṇe caiva tathaiva ca palāyane ||7|| bhṛtyānāmatha yodhānāṃ paciṇāṃ gṛhapoṣaṇe | cikitsāyāṃ tu yuddhe ca sarvatraitatpraśasyate ||8|| bhūtatantraṃ baliṃ dadyācchataṇāṃ paraghātakam | karaṇaṃ catuṣpadaṃ nāma kṛṣṇapañcadaśī divā ||9|| catuṣpadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ hitaṃ sarveṣu karmasu | śrāddhamatra ca kurvīta prayataśca mavennaraḥ ||10|| sodakāni ca kāryāṇi sarvāṇayetāni kārayet | kṛṣṇapañcadaśī rātrau nāgaṃ karaṇamucyate ||11|| naṣṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ tathā baddhaṃ tadantamiti nirdiśet | yāni prasā kāryāṇi pramadhyaharaṇāni ca || 12|| <5> śukapratipadi divā kaustubhaṃ karaṇaṃ bhavet | vaiśvadevamiti khyātaṃ praśastaṃ sarvakarmasu ||1|| bavena dhruvakarmāṇi kṣiprāṇyapi ca kārayet | prasthāne ca praveśe ca taddhi sarvārthasādhakam ||2|| bālavaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sarvārambheṣu śobhanam | cūḍopanayane yajñe vivāhe bhūtikarmasu ||3|| vayāṇāmala varṇānāmanārammo vidhīyate | anyatraṃ śobhane rāje śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ prati ||4|| maitrayukaṃ tu yatkarma yacca syātsiddhikārakam | sthāvarāṇi ca kāryāṇi kaulave tāni kārayet ||5|| rājadvārikamārambhaṃ kārayetaitile dine | etāddha' karaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ rājñopasevinām ||6|| alaṅkārāṃśa vividhān divyānyābharaṇāni ca | anyathāpi tathā yukraṃ yuktānāṃ tu pratikriyāḥ ||7|| garājinā tu kurvīta yatkarmma gṛhameghinām | paśūnāṃ poṣaṇaṃ caiva prayojyaṃ krayavikrayam ||8|| gṛhapraveśaṃ vāstūnāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ropaṇāni ca | viśeṣeṇa tu kāryāṇi karṣaṇādīni kārayet ||9|| vaṇijaṃ vakhijānāṃ tu sarvapayeṣu śobhanam | vikretā ridhyate tava kretā tatra na riṣyati ||10|| viṣṭinā karakhe karma na kuryātraiva kārayet | kṛcchreṇāpi kṛtaṃ karma mavedanpaphalodayam ||11|| yadi siddhayati tatkarma viṣṭinā tu kadācana | na taciramaśaṃkene śakyaṃ bho surairapi ||12|| āgataṃ dhananāśāya ādī kāryavināśanī | madhye prāṇaharā jñeyā viṣṭi pucche dhruvaṃ jayaḥ ||13|| bhāgantu ghaṭikāḥ pañca varttamāne caturdaśa | madhye cāṣṭī vijānīyādviṣṭipucche vayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||14|| śakunasya garutmān vṛṣabho va catuṣpade | nāgasya devatā nāgāḥ kaustubhasya dhanādhipaḥ ||15|| navasya devatā viṣṇurbālavaspa prajāpatiḥ | kaulavasya bhavetsomastaitilasya śatakratuḥ ||16|| garājivasudevatyo maṇibhadroṃ 'tha vāṇije | viṣṭestu daivataṃ mṛtyurdevatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||17|| kavirāsadivādarabhūta' divā śuciraṣṭadivākarapūrṇadivā | iti viṣṭiraharbrahaṇa rāticarāna ca karmma bhavetkṛtamāśuśubham ||18||5|| <6> ādau varjayedvīraḥ prasthāne prabhamāṃ tithim | dvitīyā samprayātasya siddhimartha vinirdiśet || 1|| tṛtīyā cemamārogyaṃ caturthī maraṇādbhayam | pañcamī vijayā śreṣṭhā sā vai sarvārthasādhakī ||2|| ṣaṣṭhī tanayalābhārya saptamī tvannabhāgbhavet | aṣṭamī rogalābhāya navamyāṃ na nivarttate ||3|| daśamyāṃ prasthito rājā bhūmilābhāya kampate | ekādaśī tu sarvatra praśastā sarvakarmasu ||4|| dvādaśī tvarthanāśāya kuryāttrayodaśī ? | caturdaśī calatkarmma kautukānyata kārayet ||5|| amāvāsyāṃ na yātrā syāt paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā divā | paurṇamāsyāṃ prayātasya na siddhistasya jāyate ||6|| ṣaḍaṣṭau nava catvāri pañcachidrāṇi varjayet | api nakṣatra sampanna varjayet caturdaśīm ||7|| nandā bhadrā jayā rikkā pūrṇā pavastu pañcamī | tithayaḥ pañca vijñeyāḥ pakṣayorubhayorapi ||8|| nandāṃ pratipadaṃ vidyāt ṣaṣṭhīmekādaśīmapi | dvitīyā saptamī bhadrā dvādaśī copapadyate ||9|| tṛtīyā cāṣṭamī caiva jayā ca syāntrayodaśī | caturthī navamī rikā tathaiva ca caturdaśī ||10|| pañcamī daśamī pūrṇā tathā pañcadaśīti ca | tithayo dveṣu vāreṣu siddhārthāstava tacchṛṇu ||11|| nandāṃ bhṛgau somasute ca madrāṃ bhaume jayāṃ sūryasuteca riktām | pūrṇā gurau pañcasu pañca ete jayāvahāḥ sarvaphalapradāya || 12|| sarṣa yugmaṃ chidramāhustithijñāḥ sāmāvāsyāṃ na dvitīyādaśamyau | ojaḥ śreṣṭha talāgaṃ tṛtīyāḥ sarvārambhā varjanīyā navamyām || 13||6|| <7> nandāyāṃ bhakṣyabhojyāni bhūṣaṇāni varastriyaḥ | ānandaṃ caiva kurvīta manaḥ priyatamāni ca ||1|| bhadrāyāṃ bhadravāśāni' yāni yogāsanāni ca | svastivācanakarmāṇi kārayedārabheti 1 ca || 2|| jayāyāṃ yojayet senāṃ vaṇijaḥ citrakāriṇaḥ | paṇyavikrayaṇaṃ kuryuḥ śastrakarma ca kārayet || 3|| rikvāyāṃ varjayenityaṃ tithau tithivicakṣaṇaḥ | bhavāṇi sarvakāryāṇi sthāvarāṇi calāni ca ||4|| pūrṇāyāṃ setubandhāṃdha koṣṭhān kośāṃtra kārayet | vāhanāni ca poṣe tu rathayānāni kārayet ||5|| evameva trirabhyastaṃ pacekheṃ parivarjayet | jyotiḥ śāstraprayuktānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladaṃ bhavet ||6|| ṛṛtucaye candramasaḥ dhaye ca pakṣacaye jyotiṣi sagrahe ca nakṣatra vargeṣu vigarhiteṣu yātrāvidhānaṃ na badanti tajjñāḥ ||7|| pacacayastu yaḥ proktaḥ kiyantaṃ kālamādiśet | ekādaśyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ vijñeyaḥ pathasaṃcaryaḥ ||8|| śukro dhanacayaṃ kuryād buddhimohaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | lohitāṃgo mahāvyādhiṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ ||9|| budho bandhuparikreśaṃ vipravāsaṃ śanaiścaraḥ | bandhupadakṣayaṃ sūryo bhayaṃ somastathaiva ca ||10|| ātmarakṣā tu nakṣatraṃ tithi syādarthasādhakī| karaṇe kāryaniṣpattirmuhurte lābhamādiśet ||11|| caturbhiḥ kārayetkarma siddhihetorvicacaṇaḥ | tithi- nakṣatra -karaṇa- muhūrceneti nityaśaḥ ||12|| titherapi ca dūratvāttibhiḥ karma samārabhet | nakṣatreṇa karaṇena muhūrtteneti nityaśaḥ ||13|| nakṣatrasya hi dūratvād dvābhyāṃ karma samārabhet | karaṇena muhūrttena tvaramāṇastu buddhimān ||14|| karaṇasya hi dūratvān muhūrttenaiva kārayet | muhūrttena kṛtaṃ karma sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||15|| dūrasthasya muhūrttasya kriyā ca tvaritā yadi | dvijapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa kṛtaṃ syātsarvasāṃpadam ||16|| nacavasya muhūrttasya titheva karaṇasya ca | caturvidhasya jñānasya śakuno daṇḍanāyakaḥ ||17|| śakuna: pavanaścaiva manaḥ parijanastathā | yasyaitānyanukūlāni siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ ||18|| na tatra balavatī tārā yatredurbalavattaraḥ | na hi marhasthitāṃ nārī kvacitsvātantryamarhati || 16 || na kṛṣṇapace śaśinaṃḥ prabhāvastārābalaṃ tava vicārya deyam | videśayate vikale ca patyau sarvāṇi kāryāṇi karoti patnī ||20|| titherekaguṇaṃḥ proklo" nacatraṃ ca caturguṇam | vārasyāṣṭaguṇaḥ proknaḥ karaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśānvitam || 21 || dvātriṃśadguye yogastārāpaṣṭisamanvitaḥ | candraḥ śataguṇaḥ proknastasācandraṃ balābalam || 22 || samīcya candrasya balābalāni grahāḥ prayachanti śubhāśubhāni | manaḥ sametāni yathendriyāṇi karmāṇayetāṃ yānti na kevalāni||23||7|| <8> ādityaḥ somo bhaumaśca tathā budhabṛhaspatī | bhārgavaḥ śanaiścaraścaicaite' saptadinādhiyāḥ || 1 || nṛpābhiṣekaṃ nṛpatiprayāṇaṃ nṛpasya kārya nṛpadarśanaṃ ca | yacādhikārya bhuvi kiścidukkaṃ tatsarvamādityadine praśastam || 2|| pānaṃ rasānāṃ madhusomapānaṃ saubhāgyakarmāṇyanulepanāni | kṣetre ca bījāni vapet vṛvān somasya kuryāddivase vidhijñaḥ ||3|| bhedābhighāto nagare pure vā senāpatitvaṃ ca tathaiva rājye | vyāyāmaśastrābhyasanaṃ ca caurya bhūmeḥ sutasyā hi sadā praśastam || 4|| dūtapraveśo rakhakāraṇārtha kanyāprajārtha ripusandhikāryam | bhine cai mantra pratisandhanīyaṃ śimaṃ praśaṃsanti dine budhasyai ||5|| strābhyāyadevārcanaveśmakārya saṃskāradīcāśca tathā yatīnām | vastrāṇi dārā śriyabhūṣarṇāni kṛṣi kuryāddevagurodine ca ||6|| aśvapravāhyaṃ prathamaṃ praśastaṃ yogapraroho gajarohaṇaṃ ca | kanyāpradānaṃ krayavikrayau ca teṣāṃ sadā śukradine praśastam ||7|| sthāpyaṃ ca karmmakratubhiśca yūpo gṛhapraveśo gajabandhanaṃ ca | grāme'tha vāso nagare pure vā śanaiścare sarvamidaṃ praśastam ||8||8|| <9> ātmakarma gurṇa śreṣṭhaṃ puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati | anpagranthaṃ mahāthe ca pravakṣyāmi bhūgormatam ||1|| pṛthak puruṣavijñeyaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ śubhāśubham | ātmasampatkaraṃ jñeyamātmana ṛddhimicchatām ||2|| navānāṃ vivargāṇāmādhāne janmakarmmaṇi | aghamottamavargeṣu sambadatīi bhāgaśaḥ ||3|| janmasampadvipakṣebhyaḥ pratvaraḥ sādhakastathā | naidhano mitravargaśca paramo maila eva tu ||4|| daramaṃ janmanakṣatrāt karmmanacalamucyate | ekonaviṃśatiṃ caiva garbhādhānakamucyate ||5|| dvitīyamekādaśaṃ viṃśameṣa sampatkaro gaṇaḥ | tṛtīyamekaviṃśaṃ tu dvādaśaṃ tu vipatkaram ||6|| cemyaṃ caturtha dvāviṃśaṃ bhavedyaca trayodaśam | pratvaraṃ pañcamaṃ vidyāttayoviṃśaṃ caturdaśam ||7|| sādhakaṃ tu caturviṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tu yat | nairdhanaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ tu ṣoḍaśaṃ saptamaṃ tathā ||8|| maitre saptadaśaṃ vidyāt ṣaḍviṃśamiti cāṣṭamam | saptaviṃśa paraṃ maitraṃ navamaṣṭādaśaṃ ca yat ||9|| navanacatrake varge prathamaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu varjayet | pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ caiva śepaiḥ kāryāṇi kārayet || 10 ||
